CA.rationale: A candidate/native_conditional origin is explicitly linked to the listed red content at the same referent/time.

COD.rationale: Content (red), an explicit organization/presentation note and a separate origin/status field are all present and bound to the same referent/time.

A.rationale: Candidate/current processing/origin entries are explicitly linked to the same content coordinates (red), indicating processing/allocation tied to content access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content entries name colors and coordinate sets for specific referents/times.

D.rationale: Content identity (red coordinates) is separately recorded from its status/origin, showing an explicit distinction.

O.rationale: The report states how content is organized/presented (grid orientation) and includes explicit origin/organization metadata for entries.
